title: Down in the Belly of the Fish

request.style: English, children's action song, bright female lead vocal with kids choir, acoustic guitar, glockenspiel, accordion, hand claps, bouncy bass, splashy fun percussion, playful sing-along, 120 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
God said, Jonah, go to Nineveh
Jonah ran the other way
Hopped aboard a ship to Tarshish
Sailing far, far away

[Verse]
Whoosh went the wind and splash went the waves
The ship began to creak and shake
The sailors cried, but Jonah slept
Down below, not yet awake

[Verse]
Over the side went Jonah, splash
And the stormy sea grew calm
Then along came a great big fish
And gulp, it swallowed Jonah down

[Chorus]
Down, down in the belly of the fish
Three days and three nights
Jonah called to God from way down deep
And God heard him, God heard him
Clap your hands, God heard him

[Bridge]
In my distress I called to the LORD, and he answered me
Salvation belongs to the LORD
Splash, the fish spat Jonah out
Onto dry land

[Verse]
Then God spoke to Jonah a second time
Get up, go to Nineveh
This time Jonah got right up
And off he went to Nineveh

[Chorus]
Down, down in the belly of the fish
Three days and three nights
Jonah called to God from way down deep
And God heard him, God heard him
Clap your hands, God heard him

[Outro]
A second time, a second chance
God heard him, God heard him
